LSTE 2026: Q-Leap looks forward to seeing you at the 8th edition of the Luxembourg Software Testing Event!

The Luxembourg Software Testing Event (LSTE) is back! On November 26, 2026, Q-Leap will host the 8th edition of this must-attend event for software testing and software quality professionals in Luxembourg.

This new edition promises great connections, enriching discussions, and many insights into the major developments in the industry.

An event that has been bringing the testing community together since 2014

Launched in 2014 by Q-Leap, the Luxembourg Software Testing Event has gradually established itself as a premier gathering for professionals in the field of software quality.

Since its inception, our goal has remained the same: to bring together testing professionals, foster knowledge sharing, and support the evolution of our field.

For this 8th edition, we are pleased to continue this journey with a community that is more engaged, curious, and passionate than ever.

More than 400 software quality professionals are expected to attend to share their experiences, discover new approaches, and discuss the challenges shaping the future of testing.

Artificial Intelligence at the Heart of the Discussions

The world of software testing is evolving rapidly. Automation, artificial intelligence, new methodologies, and the transformation of QA practices are gradually redefining how we approach software quality.

This year’s LSTE will provide a unique opportunity to explore a key question: How is artificial intelligence transforming the role of the tester and software quality practices?

On the agenda:

  • Presentations led by industry experts.

  • Practical insights and discussions on best practices.

  • Hands-on workshops to discover new tools and approaches.

  • Demonstrations of innovative solutions.

  • Networking opportunities to meet and connect with the QA community.

The goal? To leave with concrete ideas, new perspectives, and valuable professional connections.

Q-Leap is proud to host this new edition

At Q-Leap, software quality is at the heart of our expertise and our daily commitment.

For us, organizing the LSTE means going beyond our regular activities: it means actively contributing to the development of a community, encouraging the sharing of knowledge, and creating a space where professionals can freely share their experiences.

This 8th edition marks a new milestone in this collective adventure, which we are particularly pleased to continue.

Our team will also be on hand to engage with participants and showcase some of our innovations—including Q-Guard and Q-Bot—through demonstrations and dedicated workshops.

See you on November 26, 2026!

Whether you’re a tester, QA engineer, developer, quality manager, or simply passionate about new technologies, LSTE 2026 is the perfect opportunity to discover industry trends and meet the people driving innovation in software testing.

Practical Information

  • Date: Thursday, November 26, 2026

  • Time: 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.

  • Location: Hôtel Parc Belle-Vue, Luxembourg City

  • Admission: Free, registration required

Registration is now open!

Check out the program, speakers, and all the details on the official website:

https://www.lste.lu/

The entire Q-Leap team looks forward to seeing you at this 8th edition of the Luxembourg Software Testing Event!

See you at LSTE 2026!
